m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY (if present), the g2 handoff, the trajectory module source, the JointFusion oracle, and the e12_run.py reference. Verify the handoff is complete. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + handoff + module + oracle + e12 reference loaded; handoff complete

m1-unit.title: Write the unit test suite for src/preprocessing/trajectory/
m1-unit.imperative: Write tests/unit/preprocessing/trajectory/ covering: nesting oracle (StintSmoother vs JointFusion ~mm), r==1 NS==StintSmoother ~1e-10, synthetic recovery + honest heldout chi2~1, nis_series mean~1 + predvar finite/positive + unit conversions, artifact round-trip, trust-profile shape. Create __init__.py files. All fast unit tests green.
constraints: do not modify src unless genuine port bug

m2-repro.title: Write + RUN the committed Spain R end-to-end reproduction
m2-repro.imperative: Write tests/integration/test_trajectory_spain_reproduction.py (slow/integration, SKIP if data absent) re-expressing e12_run.py mechanics against src.preprocessing.trajectory with AUTOMATIC fit_stint_hp for every Spain R driver (no hardcoded HP dict), delta=0.06, real s1/s2/sf loops at FastF1 SectorNSessionTime, held-out A/B driver split, pooled robust-inlier crossing-time residuals. ASSERT pooled held-out median <= 50 ms. Run it in the FOREGROUND, write evidence json+md with per-loop/pooled med/p90/n and per-driver automatic HPs. Report the REAL number; STOP as blocker if it does not clear 50 ms (no fallback to hardcoded HPs).

postconditions.statement: integration test collects/skips cleanly and the reproduction RAN with evidence file present showing pooled median vs 50 ms

constraints: STOP on non-repro, do not weaken assertion
